scope: Technical audio suitability of police-released public footage; no location search or investigative lead
source_context: Police-supplied CCTV distributed by ABC. The publication describes the filming setting, so this is not an unknown-location benchmark. Current case status was not established.

audio_check.execution: Public Linux release in a resource-limited WSL2 VM
audio_check.interpretation: The clip fails the two-curve Doppler minimum and both the six-peak and eight-minute passage-timing minimums. It provides no sound-based location result.

preserved_setup_attempts: The first Linux attempt stopped because its separately installed URL helpers were absent from PATH. These are documented Linux prerequisites; Windows bundles them.

A second harness attempt stopped before fetching because the selected helper directory did not contain gallery-dl. The completed attempt used the qualified real downloader tools and recorded their versions and hashes.
